definitions.explanation: The act of soliciting and collecting monetary donations for a cause. Can refer both to the act of raising funds and to the donated money itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{募金|ぼきん}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They were collecting donations in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{募金|ぼきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I donated money for the disaster-affected area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧{募金|ぼきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{合計|ごうけい}→合計：02817_goukei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧10{万円|まんえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The donations collected at school totaled over 100,000 yen.

notes:
Can mean both the act of collecting donations and the donated money itself. In everyday life, {募金|ぼきん} is often seen at train stations, convenience stores, and disaster relief campaigns.

Note the usage difference: {募金|ぼきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ can mean either to donate or to raise funds depending on context, though in common usage it more often means to donate.

- {募金|ぼきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to donate; to raise funds
- {募金|ぼきん}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ — fundraising activity
- {募金|ぼきん}{箱|ばこ} — donation box
- ⟦{街頭|がいとう}→街頭：19431_gaitou⟧{募金|ぼきん} — street-corner fundraising
